question: Will a Tucker Carlson-founded political party file FEC Form 1 before September 2026?
background:
New York Post (July 2, 2026): [Tucker Carlson says he’s starting a new political party after break with Trump and GOP](https://nypost.com/2026/07/01/us-news/tucker-carlson-says-hes-starting-a-new-political-party-after-break-with-trump-and-gop/)

>Conservative podcaster Tucker Carlson intends to start a new political party after disavowing President Trump and the Republican Party over the Iran war.

>“I’m going to help build a third party,” Carlson said in an interview with the Columbia Journalism Review published Wednesday. “There should be a good-faith effort to figure out what benefits the country.”

>The former Fox News host argued that when it comes to the two issues he views as most consequential for Americans — “war and finance” — Democrats and Republicans “are in lockstep solidarity with each other.”

>“That’s not a democracy,” he said. “That’s a one-party state posing as a democracy, and it needs to be broken, and there’s going to be a third party, and I’m going to do everything I can to bring that about.”
resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, after July 3, 2026 and before September 1, 2026, a Form 1 "Statement of Organization" is filed with the US [Federal Election Commission](https://www.fec.gov/data/filings/?data_type=processed) for any political party founded or co-founded by Tucker Carlson.

question: Will July 2026 be the warmest July on record, according to Copernicus?
background:
According to the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S):

> The C3S mission is to support adaptation and mitigation policies of the European Union by providing consistent and authoritative information about climate change. We offer free and open access to climate data and tools based on the best available science. We listen to our users and endeavour to help them meet their goals in dealing with the impacts of climate change.

July 2023 set a record for the warmest July at the time, with a global average surface air temperature of 16.95°C, which was 0.72°C above the 1991–2020 average and approximately 1.48°C above the 1850–1900 pre-industrial baseline.

July 2024 was the second-warmest July on record at 16.91°C, which was 0.68°C above 1991–2020 (only 0.04°C cooler than July 2023).

July 2025 was 16.68°C, the third warmest July at the time. 

In 2026, monthly anomalies vs. 1991–2020 have been moderate compared to 2023–24:

\- February 2026: +0.53°C (5th warmest February)

\- March 2026: +0.53°C (4th warmest March)

\- April 2026: +0.52°C (3rd-warmest April)

In the second half of 2026, the El Niño Southern Oscillation (ENSO) is [forecast](https://www.noaa.gov/news-release/el-nino-forms-expected-to-strengthen-say-noaa-forecasters) to transition to a "very strong" El Niño, which could put significant upward pressure on global temperatures.
resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** July 2026 is the warmest July on record in the ERA5 [dataset](https://cds.climate.copernicus.eu/datasets/reanalysis-era5-single-levels?tab=overview), according to the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) monthly [Climate Bulletin](https://climate.copernicus.eu/climate-bulletin) covering July 2026.

question: Will Claude Mythos or a similar model be publicly released before September 2026?
background:
Claude is a series of LLMs developed by Anthropic, a prominent American AI company focused on AI safety. Over the past year, Claude became popular due to its proficiency in software engineering tasks.

According to [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Claude_\(language_model\)#Claude_Mythos):

> The existence of a model named Claude Mythos had become publicly known on March 26 \[2026] due to leaked blog post drafts. On April 7, 2026, Anthropic announced \[that] a preview of Claude Mythos ("Project Glasswing/Claude Mythos Preview") would be made available to 11 companies and organizations to find and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities. Anthropic has stated that it does not plan to make Claude Mythos Preview generally available. Anthropic said that Mythos is capable of finding critical vulnerabilities in major operating systems and web browsers. The UK AI Security Institute reported that Claude Mythos was able to solve a 32-step cyber range called "The Last Ones" 3 out of 10 times, becoming the first model to do so end-to-end. The next best models on this evaluation were Claude Opus 4.6, followed by a tie between GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.3 Codex.
>  
> Two weeks after the limited release, Mozilla announced that it had found and patched 271 security vulnerabilities in Firefox using Mythos Preview. Reportedly, a few users in a private Discord channel gained access to Mythos the same day it was announced, using details from the recent Mercor data breach. The NSA has also used Mythos, despite the fact that the DoD, its parent organization, had blacklisted Anthropic after a dispute. In April 2026, the Chinese government requested access to Mythos, but was rebuffed.
resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as Yes if Claude Mythos or an equivalent Claude model is released to the public before September 1, 2026.

question: Will Death Valley hit 125 degrees in August 2026?
background:
Death Valley, California holds the [Guinness World Record](https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/highest-recorded-temperature) for the hottest air temperature ever recorded, (134°F (56.7°C) in July 1913, though that observation has recently come under serious [dispute](https://journals.ametsoc.org/view/journals/bams/107/1/BAMS-D-24-0313.1.xml). In recent years, 129.9°F (54.4°C) was recorded in [August 2020](https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/sites/hist.phtml?station=DEVC1\&network=CA_DCP\&year=2020\&month=8), and 129°F was recorded as recently as [July 2024](https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/sites/hist.phtml?station=DEVC1\&network=CA_DCP\&year=2024\&month=7). 

Recent Augusts have reached the following highs:

| Year | August maximum |
| ---: | -------------: |
| 2016 |          122°F |
| 2017 |          127°F |
| 2018 |          122°F |
| 2019 |          122°F |
| 2020 |      130°F |
| 2021 |          126°F |
| 2022 |          123°F |
| 2023 |      120°F |
| 2024 |          124°F |
| 2025 |          124°F |
resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if Death Valley, CA, records a maximum temperature on any day in August 2026 of greater than or equal to 125 °F, according to the observations at the [Furnace Creek Visitors Center](https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/sites/hist.phtml?station=DEVC1\&network=CA_DCP) weather station.
